about: One-click starts. An app opens one of the studio's own forms with its choices already made; it adds no model of its own. needs = features of models.py; lora = a LoRA named by pattern (the app works without it, and says what it would add).

apps.name: Text to video
apps.line: A clip with sound from a description.

apps.name: Image to video
apps.line: A picture becomes the first frame of a clip.

apps.name: First and last frame
apps.line: A clip that opens on one picture and ends on another.

apps.name: Reference to video
apps.line: Up to nine pictures of who and what must look the same, in a scene you describe.

apps.name: Scout, then animate
apps.line: Make a few stills in seconds, pick one, animate it.

apps.name: Long take
apps.line: One shot longer than 15 s: parts that continue each other in latent space, one beat a part.

apps.name: A film, shot by shot
apps.line: Bible, cast, places, shots, a gate after every part, one film at the end.

apps.name: Storyboard
apps.line: A still for every shot from the cast's own pictures, before any clip is rendered.

apps.name: Night shift
apps.line: Render the rest of a film overnight; dailies reel and notes in the morning.

apps.name: Talking head
apps.line: One person says your line to the camera, lips in sync.

form.action: {who} looks into the camera and speaks in a friendly, natural way, with small head movements.

apps.name: Two people talking
apps.line: A conversation with exact lines; they look at each other, not at the lens.

apps.name: Invent a face
apps.line: A face reference for a new character, so every shot can show the same person.

apps.name: Turnaround sheet
apps.line: One picture of a character turned into a sheet: front, side, back.

apps.name: Multiple angles
apps.line: The same subject from several directions, one picture each.

apps.name: Cast library
apps.line: Characters kept across films: face, outfit sheet, voice sample, LoRA.

apps.name: Catwalk
apps.line: A runway walk that holds together: stop, pose, one half turn, walk away.

form.action: {who} walks down the runway toward the camera, stops at the end and holds a pose, shifts into a second pose, makes one half turn and walks away, the back to the camera. The whole body from head to feet stays in frame.
form.sound: A steady electronic runway beat, camera shutters, a murmuring audience.

apps.name: Camera moves
apps.line: Twenty-nine moves by name: push-in, orbit, crane, whip pan, dolly zoom...

apps.name: Bullet time
apps.line: The action freezes while the camera orbits it.

form.action: 0.00-3.00s: {who} runs and jumps. 3.00-7.00s: bullet-time. Time slows almost completely: {who} stays frozen in mid-air while the camera performs a smooth 180-degree orbital movement around. 7.00-10.00s: time snaps back to normal speed and {who} lands.

apps.name: FPV fly-through
apps.line: A fast first-person flight through a place.

apps.name: Orbit
apps.line: The camera circles the subject.

apps.name: Fight scene
apps.line: Choreographed blows in one wide take.

form.action: Two fighters face each other. The first throws a fast punch, the second blocks it and answers with a kick; they trade two more blows and step apart, breathing hard.
form.sound: Sharp impacts, cloth snapping, fast footwork on the floor, heavy breathing.

apps.name: Every look
apps.line: Eighteen looks, lenses and lights as words.

apps.name: One shot, many looks
apps.line: The same shot rendered in several looks, side by side.

apps.name: Home video tape
apps.line: The 1990s camcorder look.

apps.name: Hand-drawn animation
apps.line: 2D cel animation.

apps.name: Film noir
apps.line: Black and white, hard light.

apps.name: Product sheet
apps.line: A photo of a thing becomes a clean two-view sheet, so it looks the same in every shot.

apps.name: Product ad
apps.line: Your product, lit like a commercial, with a slow move.

form.action: The product stands on a clean reflective surface. Light sweeps across it and small highlights travel over its edges.
form.sound: A soft modern synth pad, one clean whoosh.

apps.name: Selfie review
apps.line: A vertical phone video: a person holds the product and says your line.

form.action: {who} holds the product up next to the face with one hand, looks into the phone camera and talks about it with a smile.

apps.name: Voice-over
apps.line: A line spoken in a voice from a sample.

apps.name: Voice samples
apps.line: 10-20 s of a voice; the video model speaks lines in it.

apps.name: Captions
apps.line: What is said in a clip, as subtitles, heard on this computer.

apps.name: Location sound
apps.line: Studio-clean dialogue re-mixed as recorded on location.

apps.name: Cut to the beat
apps.line: Find a song's beats and lay the clips on them.

apps.name: Extend a clip
apps.line: Carry a clip on from its own last frames and sound.

apps.name: Upscale
apps.line: 1.5x larger and 48 frames a second.

apps.name: Timeline
apps.line: Order, trim, level and export.

apps.name: To DaVinci Resolve
apps.line: The cut as ProRes with PCM sound, an FCPXML and an EDL.

apps.name: Dailies reel
apps.line: Every new take after a title card, with what the checks found.

apps.name: Library
apps.line: Everything made here.

apps.name: Prompt check
apps.line: What a prompt will trip over, before it costs a render.

apps.name: Machine
apps.line: Models, nodes, memory, what can run.

apps.name: For your agent
apps.line: The API and the MCP tools an agent drives the studio with.

templates.portrait: Photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait photo of an ordinary person, an original fictional character: {text} Facing the camera straight on, eyes looking into the lens, neutral light grey studio background, soft even daylight, sharp focus on the face, 85mm photo, natural skin texture.
templates.location: Photorealistic cinematic film still, wide 35mm frame at eye level, an empty place: {text} Plain surfaces free of lettering. Sharp, detailed, natural film grain.
templates.propsheet: Create a clean product reference sheet on a plain white background, studio lighting, photorealistic. The object is {text} from Picture 1, exactly the same object. Show it twice, side by side, the whole object in frame with space around it: on the left a full side view, on the right a three-quarter rear view. Every part of it is visible in BOTH views.
templates.outfit: Create a character reference sheet on a plain light grey background, even studio lighting, photorealistic. The person from Picture 1, the same face and hair, {text}. Show the whole body from head to feet four times side by side: from the front, from the back, in three-quarter view and from the side. The same person and the same clothes in all four views.
